record.question: The ________ is attached at the time of assembling of medical record and after completion of medical record it is removed.
record.explanation: Answer C: Deficiency check. A deficiency-check slip is attached while assembling a record to note missing items and removed after the record is complete. Reference: https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/208125/9290610050_rev_eng.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
